Supreme Court Issues Notice to CJP, Congress, AAP Over Ramlila Maidan Protests

The Supreme Court has issued notices to the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), the Congress party, and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) in response to a plea seeking a ban on protests at Ramlila Maidan and Jantar Mantar. Traders claimed that these demonstrations are impacting their businesses. The court's action follows a petition that highlighted the disruption caused by protests in these public spaces.
